title: Kevin Kline Joins Meryl Streep in Netflix's The Corrections
excerpt:
The Oscar winners reunite for an adaptation of Jonathan Franzen's novel.
Cord Jefferson will direct every episode of the limited series.
body_md:
Kline plays Alfred Lambert, the husband of Streep's Enid. Alfred is a once-authoritative patriarch confronting aging and a changing relationship with his three adult children. His strict principles collide with their modern lives and unresolved family tensions.

Based on Jonathan Franzen's National Book Award-winning novel, the limited drama follows a Midwestern family whose mother hopes to bring everyone together for one last Christmas. Each sibling struggles with ambitions and personal difficulties that complicate the reunion. The story blends family drama with comedy.

Franzen adapted his own novel and executive produces alongside American Fiction filmmaker Cord Jefferson, who directs every episode. Streep is also an executive producer.

The casting reunites Kline and Streep more than four decades after Sophie's Choice, Kline's feature debut. They subsequently appeared together in A Prairie Home Companion and Ricki and the Flash. Kline's recent television work includes Disclaimer and American Classic. Netflix has not announced a premiere date.
